title: The API saves an automatic move that points at a transition from another state; it never runs

panels.caption: TAVI API: auto-move on Open pointing at Escalated → Closed saved (201) and never scheduled; the same mistake in the reply trigger is refused
Zoho: Auto Transition is a switch on the transition itself
TAVI designer of the saved blueprint: Open shows a "5m" timer, no issue banner, no auto-move setting in the panel

rows: Automatic move set to a transition that starts at another state
Auto Transition is switched on inside the transition, so it always belongs to the state that transition starts from.

State Open with autoTransitionId "esc2" (Escalated → Closed) answers 201 Created and is saved. The same mistake in "When the customer replies" is refused: "'esc2' is not a transition out of this state".
The blueprint can be made active; the ticket enters at Open, auto_due_at stays null and after 100 s (move set to 1 minute) it is still at Open. The designer shows a "5m" timer on Open as if it works.
